claims.enforcement_effect: Configured execution-budget boundary could limit delivery of advisory checks; actual host behavior is unverified.

Exec form, event and advisory failure policy represented; fixed event-specific budget is absent from the action.

claims.distinguishing_behavioral_scenario: A slow post-bash invocation under PostToolUse for Bash or PowerShell exceeds the configured budget while satisfying all command-form and failure-policy constraints. Changing only this registration budget leaves the others unchanged.
claims.open_question: Does the frozen configuration produce an independent execution limit in the intended host, and with which timeout semantics?
